note: Tenth set (2026-11-12): chains of actions and walking on the toes or heels, for prompt v12 (sequence, foot_pitch). Written by Claude before any model was run on it; none of the commands is a v12 example in other words except that C1 and C2 share their actions with the examples (walk then run, run then jump) in different wording. Group C asks for two or three actions in a row: expect_sequence is the order of actions the answer must give. Group T asks for walking on the toes or the heels: expect_foot_pitch is the sign the answer's foot_pitch must have. Do not edit after its first run.
